content:
The wiki doesn't cover controls. Let me reconsider the primitive design once more.

Key insight I may have missed: the `interact` primitive "walks next to the tile, faces it, presses the button." Maybe `button` is meant to be a **mouse button** but the valid values are the literal words the engine uses. I've tried left/right/middle/primary/secondary/click/lmb/rmb/mouse1/mouse2. 

But wait — what about **"left_click"**, **"right_click"**, **"mouse_left"**, **"mouse_right"**, **"button1"**, **"button2"**, **"button_left"**? And for raw_input, maybe the vocabulary is **"click"** style. Let me also reconsider: maybe the whole issue is that `interact` needs `button` to be one of a tiny set and I should try **"use"** on a real soil tile (I only tried "use" on the notice board at 3,7). Actually "use" failed at 3,7.

Let me try the underscore variants and "button1/button2" on a soil tile.

args.approach: Try underscore/button-number variants (left_click, right_click, mouse_left, mouse_right, button1, button2, button_left, button_right) on a soil tile with the hoe — these formats haven't been tried.
